results.prompt: Describe the feeling of rain on your skin.
results.text: The first thing is the storm — it arrives before thought, the way drop arrives before grey. Then the details gather: rain has a texture you could almost hold, layered and unhurried, and somewhere underneath it all sits skin, quiet and persistent. It asks nothing of you — it simply continues, indifferent and complete, and somehow that is what makes the rain worth noticing.
